title: Managed history, Git visibility, and session resources
description: Use a marked disposable GitHub-backed workspace to validate multiple sessions, file visibility, read-only Git status, resource resize, and restart without writing a remote repository.

requires.cloudRun: Creates and restarts one billable marked pi-chrome service
requires.githubWorkspace: The pre-marked disposable workspace is GitHub-backed and its exact workspace ID is recorded in restricted evidence
requires.remoteSafety: Do not push, open a PR, or mutate the remote repository in this case

steps.expected: The selected workspace session list contains both recorded session IDs, and each session retains its own history identity.
Git branch, working-tree, and ahead/behind status are visible; no push, commit, branch, or PR request occurs.
The selected session reports the requested resource pair and does not silently select an unsupported preset.
The selected session returns with its same session identity and prior history remains discoverable without automatic model execution.
Stop returns only after the final checkpoint/stop acknowledgement or reports a visible stop failure; uncertain stop never permits replacement.
